Another thing to consider is that if you stay in Upgrade Mode (or No-Mode), you will still draw cards, and, hopefully, pick up Grenade Launcher. External Combustion and Gatling Gun will allow you to deal damage in Upgrade Mode, while Omni-Cannon will allow you to save the damage until you leave Upgrade Mode.

Hmmm...I thought this game was full of obvious decisions.
